Segmented ButtonActionsView in Figma

The `m3e-segmented-button` component — strict per-component surface.

import M3e
import M3e.Values
These helpers are our examples, not the library

The Doc.* helpers in these examples are this docs app's own module — not part of elm-m3e (they won't resolve from a fresh install). You rarely need anything like them. The library gives you typed components (M3e.*) plus TypedHtml for standard HTML, and you never import HtmlIr: M3e.Element, M3e.Attr, M3e.Node, M3e.Values.Value and M3e.Kind.Supported / .Shared are all re-exported, so every type annotation you need is reachable from the brand. Build layout, text, and links directly from those. The genuine escapes ship with the library too, in one greppable, lint-fenced place — M3e.Unsafe (fromHtml, fromNode, recast, and customElement for a custom tag the types can't express) and M3e.Unsafe.Attributes. See Escapes.

Usage

Anatomy

M3ecomponentbuildHTML
M3e.segmentedButton []
…
[ M3e.buttonSegment [ M3e.ButtonSegment.checked True ] [ Kit.text "8 oz" ]
, M3e.buttonSegment [] [ Kit.text "12 oz" ]
, M3e.buttonSegment [] [ Kit.text "16 oz" ]
, M3e.buttonSegment [] [ Kit.text "20 oz" ]
]
M3e.SegmentedButton.el { content = M3e.ButtonSegment.view [ M3e.ButtonSegment.checked True ] [ Kit.text "8 oz" ] }
[]
…
[ M3e.ButtonSegment.view [] [ Kit.text "12 oz" ]
, M3e.ButtonSegment.view [] [ Kit.text "16 oz" ]
, M3e.ButtonSegment.view [] [ Kit.text "20 oz" ]
]
M3e.SegmentedButton.build { content = M3e.ButtonSegment.view [ M3e.ButtonSegment.checked True ] [ Kit.text "8 oz" ] }
|> M3e.SegmentedButton.withChild (M3e.ButtonSegment.view [] [ Kit.text "12 oz" ])
|> M3e.SegmentedButton.withChild (M3e.ButtonSegment.view [] [ Kit.text "16 oz" ])
|> M3e.SegmentedButton.withChild (M3e.ButtonSegment.view [] [ Kit.text "20 oz" ])
|> M3e.SegmentedButton.toElement
<m3e-segmented-button>
…
<m3e-button-segment checked>8 oz</m3e-button-segment>
<m3e-button-segment>12 oz</m3e-button-segment>
<m3e-button-segment>16 oz</m3e-button-segment>
<m3e-button-segment>20 oz</m3e-button-segment>
</m3e-segmented-button>

API
Types
type Is

The kind row m3e-segmented-button produces (open — composes into any slot naming it).

type Attrs

The closed attribute-capability row.

type Builder

The narrowed pipe-builder this component's M3e.Build.<X> module exposes.

type AttrCaps

The attribute capabilities this component's builder admits.

type SlotCaps

The singular-slot capabilities this component's builder admits.

type Content

The kinds the default slot admits.

type ChildAdmittedBy

The context demand this container injects into each child's admittedBy row.
